where: Run start > Documents step, 'Issuer and case date' (Issuer name field)
limits: Required. Must equal the earlier run's issuer name after case and whitespace folding to be a CP-8 comparison base (the review sheet shows the reason when it does not).

decided_by: the user (read-only when started from an earlier run)
where: Run start > Documents step, 'Issuer and case date'
limits: Pattern [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39}, at most 40 characters; compared without regard to case for CP-8; a name with no ASCII letter or digit gives no slug.

where: Run start > Documents step, 'Issuer and case date' (as-of field)
limits: Date as ISO; CP-8 compares only with an earlier run whose as-of date is on or before this run's; the run's period labels come from the source files.

where: Run start > Documents step ('Case kind' select)
limits: Web research and lookup run for public and private cases, never for a synthetic case; a private case is told before Submit that the issuer's name and research questions go to the search provider.

where: Run start > Documents step ('Run form level')
limits: Advanced adds model, effort, turns per module, module selection and valuation and assumption fields; switching back to Basic clears a module selection.

decision: Documents (add, remove, carry from an earlier run)
where: Run start > Documents step (file upload list; 'start from an earlier run' via ?from=<run>)
limits: The page reads each file and lists documents with those it ignored and why; 'start from an earlier run' copies documents and answers only and carries no run id; documents or answers changed after approval refuse Submit; Excel and CSV files are inputs only.

where: Run start > Documents step (analyst name field)

where: Not asked on either start page

where: Run start > Purpose step
limits: Module list as in the preset (CP-0, CP-1, CP-MODEL, CP-1A, CP-DR, CP-2, CP-2A, CP-2D, CP-2E, CP-2G, CP-4, CP-3C, CP-5; from web/src/pages/connected/api.ts); hard cap USD 20.

where: Run start > Purpose step
limits: Module list as in the preset (CP-0, CP-1, CP-1A, CP-1C, CP-DR, CP-2, CP-2A, CP-2E, CP-2G, CP-2H, CP-4, CP-4C, CP-5; from web/src/pages/connected/api.ts); hard cap USD 20.

where: Run start > Purpose step
limits: Module list as in the preset (CP-0, CP-1, CP-MODEL, CP-DR, CP-2, CP-2E, CP-3, CP-5, CP-6; from web/src/pages/connected/api.ts); portfolio workbook asked and a missing one stays a Gap; hard cap USD 20.

where: Not offered on run start; a new run is refused at the launcher, the summary and the inbox submit
limits: Message 'The short credit snapshot is deactivated. Use the lite credit assessment.'; past runs stay readable in the library; its cap row (USD 20) is retained in the table.

decided_by: fixed by ruling (not chosen by the user)
where: Shown on Run start (Purpose, Confirm, Start) and on Run activity (each run's cap); sent with each summary and Submit as X-Shown-Cap
limits: Lite 15, Full 25, Deep 40, the five purpose pathways 20 (USD); hard: a call is refused when spend plus its hold would pass the cap and the run stops as 'capped'; the launcher refuses a --cap above the pathway's cap, a lower cap is allowed; a stale page without the right shown cap is refused ('Reload the page'); a summary records its cap and Submit refuses if the table now differs; no spend estimate is shown; spend and caps are in USD whatever the issuer's currency.

decision: Module selection (preset or leave modules out)
decided_by: the user (Advanced) within the pathway's preset; CP-OS orders what remains
where: Run start > More context step, Advanced fields ('Requested modules'), and the review sheet's 'Leave out <module names>' button
limits: Only modules of the chosen pathway; CP-MODEL publishes the forecast and is not drawn as a module; CP-8 is in no preset and cannot be selected; a module's blocking upstream producers must be present or the review sheet names what will refuse; a run with modules left out leaves their report sections unfilled and is not used as the earlier run in a later Changes comparison; Basic level selects the whole preset.

where: Not a user control; shown on the review sheet and Run activity
limits: The plan orders modules by dependencies (for example CP-DR and CP-1C before CP-2 and CP-3 in Deep); CP-5 reads all analyst handoffs; CP-8 runs last when an earlier run of the same issuer and pathway is listed.

decided_by: the user (Advanced only; default GPT Sol)
where: Run start > More context step, Advanced fields ('Model')
limits: Only gpt-6.1-sol or claude-opus-5-5; web search applies to GPT Sol runs only; the caps are the same for every model.

where: Run start > More context step, Advanced fields ('Reasoning effort')
limits: Fast = every module medium, Balanced = high on the modules the effort map names and medium on the rest, High = every module high.

where: Run start > More context step, Advanced fields
limits: Whole number 1 to 64; Basic always sends 32.

decision: Web search and lookup for the research module
decided_by: CP-OS (fixed by ruling), disclosed to the user
where: Run start review sheet statement shown before Submit
limits: Offered for public and private cases, off for synthetic; search applies to GPT Sol; lookup limited to the allowlist (web_allowlist.json, including finance.yahoo.com); the page states it whenever the research module will search or look up, and says Yahoo sees the issuer's ticker in the page address.

decision: Earlier run that Changes compares with
decided_by: CP-OS chooses; the user approves it in the summary
where: Run start > Review and start step ('Changes' row of the review sheet)
limits: Same issuer id, pathway, case kind and equal issuer name, as-of on or before; latest by as-of then first call start; runs with explicit module subsets are not bases; if none, 'first run'; if the named run later fails the tests the run proceeds without CP-8 and records 'not compared'; CP-8 is one more call under the same cap and fails open.

decision: Run summary (readiness and what will run)
decided_by: CP-OS / run start service on the user's request
where: Run start > Review and start step (connected); Confirm step (static)
limits: The service refuses a summary without the displayed cap (X-Shown-Cap); an answers error returns an error and no digest; the summary shows the modules, omitted modules with titles, readiness items, cap, model, effort, changes and web lookup.

decision: Accepting a run limit (decisions on the review sheet)
where: Run start > Review and start step (limit cards with accept checkboxes and fixes; connected); Confirm step (static)
limits: Every undecided limit must be accepted, or a module left out, before approval is enabled ('N decisions left before you can approve').

where: Run start > Review and start step (approval checkbox; connected); Confirm step (static)
limits: Submit stays disabled until the summary is approved and all checks are complete; editing the documents or answers after approval invalidates it (the digest changes).

decided_by: the user (explicit action; the only paid action the build allows)
where: Run start > Review and start step ('Submit, spend up to <cap>') then the confirmation dialog 'Start a paid run?' (connected); Start step (static)
limits: Only on an approved summary and the pathway's cap; POST must carry the service's own Origin; the provider key comes only from the launching environment, never a file; no credential in any file; a Submit after an error in the summary is refused as 'documents or answers changed after approval'.

decision: Submit in a synthetic or proof run
where: Run start > Review and start step ('Submit run'; dialog 'Start a synthetic test?')
limits: Starts the synthetic engine with a network-disabled launcher; no provider call, no spend.

decision: Paid execution outside the run start page
where: Not a page control (command line / owner instruction)
limits: Needs offline readiness first; each paid run needs its own ruling or the standing run-start ruling; no credential file.

where: Not a user control; shown on Run activity as queued then running
limits: The service starts the launcher with --cap and --prior from the approved summary; run states are queued, running, finished, failed, capped, rejected, interrupted.

decision: Retry of a refused module draft
where: Not a user control; draft rejections appear as events on Run activity and Evidence > Record
limits: Mechanical prose and fidelity checks block a handoff and send a targeted repair request within the existing retry and cost cap; at most the module's writes (three); CP-8 alone may fail open.

decision: Retry of a failed Submit request
where: Run start > Review and start step (message 'Retrying Submit run is safe.')
limits: Safe to repeat the request: it cannot start a second run of the same submission.

decision: Resume of an interrupted or capped run
decided_by: CP-OS resumes affected work; the user relaunches into the same run folder (no page control found)
where: Not on either start page or Run activity; by launcher relaunch into the same folder
limits: Resumes only at the folder's own cap, which never rises (a USD 20 folder resumes only at 20); accepted handoffs replay from retained responses with no new call; the launcher never resends a module that already started; a folder prepared before a method change that alters the request is refused.
source_of_rule: docs/rulings/2026-11-15-pathway-tiers-and-caps.md (Caps, last bullets); docs/rulings/2026-11-13-tdg-full-copilot-sol-rerun.md (Extension, never-resend guard); AGENTS.md (CP-OS resumes affected work); see harmony-report H-15

where: Run activity (status 'capped', cap and spend labelled)
limits: A call is refused when spend plus its hold would pass the cap; a hold is about USD 5.73 per GPT Sol call whatever its size, so a run needs about its spend plus 5.73; the run stops as capped, possibly before CP-6 or CP-8.

where: Module page and navigator ('Not assessable'); Run activity
limits: A blocked module still delivers a Bottom line saying why; downstream modules receive a Blocked handoff and stop at their own gate; nothing is skipped.

where: Not a user control; the run's Overview, Changes, Modules, Forecast and Evidence pages are populated from the actual handoffs and checked against them
limits: Delivery adds no analysis, only selects and orders module-written passages, every number and qualification exact; a missing handoff passage stays an explicit gap or a targeted repair request; completion is the five library pages populated, not handoff generation; the separate HTML report is retired.

decided_by: CP-OS / service configuration (not a user control)
where: Launching environment only (CREDIT_OS_TEAMS_WEBHOOK and CREDIT_OS_TEAMS_LINK)
limits: Posts only when both variables are set; sends issuer name, pathway, analyst name, times, counts, cap, run id, link and a finished run's lead bottom line; no document, source reference, file name, path, hash, reason text or spend; the webhook is never logged, stored or shown. Open R8 question: the ruling allows this outbound POST, but audit ruling R8 names no exception for it (harmony-report H-26); stage 2 and the lead or owner settle it.

decision: Choosing an issuer and a run to read

limits: Runs that did not complete remain listed with their recorded state; earlier-format and earlier-methods labels remain. Static pages are qualified saved design examples rather than a live admission writer.
